Live at Bar CJ

Final night we're down at the CJ bar with friends — screen up, cold drinks, full volume. Whatever happens, we're watching every second of it together.

Minigame

Take the penalty

Two taps. First stop the sweeping arrow between the posts (green = on target, red = wide). Then stop the pulsing power ring: reach the green ring and you bury it in the top corner — but overshoot into the red and it flies over the bar. Stay below green and the keeper saves it if he dives your way. Five shots — go score.
